title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.89
summary: Stabiler HTTPS-Cloud-Medienrelay bei vielen Kameras: laengere Agenten-Polls, gestueckelte HLS-Antworten und verbesserte Fehlerdiagnose.
changes: Extend camera-agent polling timeout from 12s to 25s when portal is busy
Send HLS media responses above 360KB as ordered 480KB Base64 chunks to avoid Plesk request-body limits
Permit media responses up to 4MiB and retry transient HTTP failures
Add detailed cloud-media transfer errors and regression tests
Private PHP 3.0.5 uses short polling requests and limits visible camera thumbnail concurrency to two
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.89
description: Reliable outbound-only Plesk HTTPS media relay for multi-camera installations
releaseNotes: Requires separately deployed private Plesk PHP V3.0.5 for result-chunk and asynchronous thumbnails. Keep cloud registration ID, user accounts and recordings unchanged.
